text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Truly a raging tempest!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming her injury right after her 
debut, she has shown her true strength, 
Cesario――!
(Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...! Alright!

Having weathered the harsh winter, the 
green sprouts burgeoned with strength――and 
her performance became the talk of the 
town!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Man, with the Triple Tiara trail 
approaching, all the star players have 
gathered!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume currently turning everyone's 
heads, Rhein Kraft! In the recent GⅡ race, 
she caught the front-runner Daring Heart 
with a brilliant burst of late speed to 
claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Boasting a stellar record since her debut 
race, and fresh off a fierce clash with 
Line Craft, here is the elite Umamusume, 
Daring Heart!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
True to her mother's pedigree, she 
consistently contends at the front with 
solid running! Expectations soar for her 
in the Triple Tiara—Air Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, Cesario, who put on a 
spectacular performance at the Flower Cup!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing, isn't she? With a running 
style so full of fighting spirit, she has 
an overwhelming presence...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First up is the Oka Sho. I'm really 
looking forward to seeing what kind of 
fierce battle unfolds!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It feels like the time has finally come, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Our fresh start is off to an auspicious 
beginning, but we must not let our guard 
down.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Giving it our all for the upcoming Oka 
Sho... Let us connect this result to our 
future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...And that's why.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, here's that sour 
American candy♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. That sounds terrifying, just how 
sour is it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat all together. On the count of 
three!

In any case, the Flower Cup came to an end 
in a cheerful atmosphere.

Next up is—the Triple Tiara. Many a 
protagonist shall grace this magnificent 
first act.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! As if I'd ever settle for staring 
at her back!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...So please, look forward to the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'll... work really, really hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will run the turf with the same strength 
as Mother— and prove to the world just how 
strong you are.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*... *wheeze*! *wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...gh... *cough*...! So far away...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it, I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, aaah! Just one more time, just one 
more time...!

"To bathe in the cherry blossom 
spotlight—everyone races toward the Oka 
Sho."
